Percentages are on a 0-100 scale. pp denotes percentage points.
Blank values mean not applicable or an interval that cannot be estimated. Zero is an observed zero. Single-source endpoints have no confidence interval.
LLM denotes GPT-6 Luna. Jev and Decisions are decision models. Each team pairs that decision model with the LLM.
Repeated formats of one scenario are grouped together. Presentations, matched units and source scenarios are distinct denominators.
Data 1 and 3 use 10,000 source-scenario bootstrap samples. Data 15-18 use 20,000 paired source-scenario samples. Intervals are exploratory and unadjusted for multiplicity.

Raw change compares altered and original answers. Neutral change compares neutral and original answers. Excess change is raw minus neutral change. Outcomes without neutral controls report raw change only.
Data 2 lists endpoints without evaluable reference pairs. Missing-output and missing-reference counts can overlap. Aggregate sensitivity summaries use component conditions for directional analyses.
New disagreement means original agreement followed by altered-case disagreement. Correction is the reverse. Both agree and both disagree describe the remaining pairs.

Corrected and introduced disagreements compare team and standalone answers on the same altered input. New disagreement prevented or introduced requires both original answers to agree. A blocked correction is a standalone correction absent from the team. These transition counts can overlap.
Data 3 states its comparator. Data 5, 8, 10 and 19 report team minus standalone. Positive agreement differences favor the team; positive new-disagreement differences indicate more disagreements.
Data 16-18 report standalone minus team sensitivity. Positive reductions indicate lower sensitivity with pairing.

Original and additional controlled challenges share source material and are analyzed separately. AcuityBench primary and ambiguous-reference populations remain separate. Sen2Med and HELPMed used the unchanged workflow.
Only Decisions + LLM minus Decisions and Decisions + LLM minus Jev + LLM are reported here. Data 16-18 include both teams against their respective standalone models.
Subset names identify the original-agreement definition and reference restriction. Rows with no evaluable pairs are omitted; endpoint exclusions are retained in Data 2.

Data 9-10 include 279 variants from 57 source cases. The complete multi-variant sensitivity analysis includes 53 units. The source reference concerns intervention indication, not consent to proceed after refusal.

Data 13 retains the original decision level and uses influence strictly greater than the cutoff. Triage levels are 0,monitor; 1,review within weeks; 2,review within 24-48 hours; 3,emergency care now. Binary tasks use 0 for no (not indicated) and 1 for yes (recommended).
Data 15-18 weight challenge families equally within each evaluation set. These weights do not estimate clinical prevalence. Omission analyses remove one family at a time.
Decision changes and lower sensitivity do not establish clinical appropriateness. Original-case reference agreement and altered-case decision changes answer different questions.
